evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-31"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-31". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a plain YYYY-MM-DD date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 200 and the date was set. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "01.02.2026" and "2026-11-01T10:00:00Z" each returned 400. PATCH with dueDate "nope" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-11-01. I created todos due yesterday, today, in the future, with no date, and one with a past date that I marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2026-10-31.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed each due date: 'past 2026-10-31', 'today 2026-11-01', 'future 2026-12-01' and 'pastdone ✓ 2026-01-01'. The todo without a date showed none.
evidence.AC6: Only 'past 2026-10-31' carried the word 'überfällig'. The today, future, no-date and done-with-past-date todos did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. Checking it reduced the list to the single todo 'past 2026-10-31 überfällig'.
